notes.title: Groove Catcher alpha update
notes.content: Hey alpha testers! We've been moving slowly but surely. This update mainly has new scenery, audio previewing, along with some bug fixes and small changes. What do you think??

notes.title: Groove Catcher is the alternative, flowing rhythm game you've been waiting for
notes.content:
Live event Sat 4pm https://www.twitch.tv/vizmoovr

We're proud to show you Groove Catcher - a merging of a flowing rhythm game, dance and music visualization. This alpha version has all the components of our vision - play it now and get the experience.

Bill and I are both lifelong amateur musicians, dancers and tech geeks. We started this as a tool for music visualization to create dynamic music sculptures based on how you dance. We flipped the tool around and everyone who tried it had fun catching each other's grooves, so we made a full-fledged game of it. We use all of our experience as improv musicians and dancers to create levels that get you deep into the music and movement. Then you can capture the feel of the music how YOU feel it by making your own levels.

We take a more laid-back approach to the rhythm game genre, with lots of flow and space for mellow and musically-immersive levels. Yet we can also make very intense levels that will push you to keep up. And no matter what, it's tight with the music and groove.

We've got a natural, in-game level builder because we want everyone to discover and share their own grooves and style. You can sideload your own songs and make levels, or use the wide range of songs we have in the game already. A site for sharing levels with other players is in the works and will be integrated right in the game.

We hope Groove Catcher gets you immersed in the music and in your body. Show us your grooves!

- Michael & Bill
